cards.name: spray_4
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Sprayer list (category Misc). Shipped preview (the .cdr file's own embedded thumbnail, not a script render) shows a row of flat cartoon woodland animals: an orange fox, a brown rabbit, a grey mouse, a brown beaver, a green turtle and a brown bear, each a separate clip-art figure. Sprayed along a path, these objects repeat with the spacing, size and rotation set on the property bar.
use_for: children's book borders and nursery wall art
avoid: Serious or premium layouts: the figures are simple clip-art; scale stays naive at any size.
Long or dense paths: object count and redraw time climb fast; raise Spacing or lower Dabs on the property bar.
Editing one sprayed object or sending to apps that need plain vectors: Object > Break Artistic Media Apart and ungroup first.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: copies of the spraylist objects are placed along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool in Sprayer mode, or apply to a selected curve); the result is an Artistic Media group that follows the path when it is reshaped
cards.how_to_apply: Artistic Media tool (I) > Sprayer on the property bar > Category 'Misc' > Sprayer list 'spray_4'; pick it before dragging, or select an existing curve and pick it to spray along it (Effects > Artistic Media docker lists it too). Tune object size, Dabs / Spacing, Spray order and Rotation on the property bar. Script: the harvest records no call that applies a sprayer; the spraylist artwork is in C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Misc\spray_4.cdr. Scripted substitute: import that file and place copies along the path with SubPath.GetPointAt / SubPath.GetTangentAt + Shape.Duplicate (static copies with no live link to the path; not tested by the harvest).

verified.note: Six flat cartoon animals in a row: orange fox, brown rabbit, grey mouse, brown beaver with flat tail, green turtle, brown bear.

Shipped preview (the .cdr file's own embedded thumbnail, not a script render) shows aircraft clip-art: a white business jet, a jumbo airliner, a small prop plane with a blue stripe, a blue-and-white helicopter and a Concorde, mostly white and light grey. Sprayed along a path, these objects repeat with the spacing, size and rotation set on the property bar.
avoid: Dark backgrounds are fine, but on white the pale planes lose their edges.
Long or dense paths: object count and redraw time climb fast; raise Spacing or lower Dabs on the property bar.
Editing one sprayed object or sending to apps that need plain vectors: Object > Break Artistic Media Apart and ungroup first.
cards.applies_to: open path or curve: copies of the spraylist objects are placed along the path (draw with the Artistic Media tool in Sprayer mode, or apply to a selected curve); the result is an Artistic Media group that follows the path when it is reshaped
cards.how_to_apply: Artistic Media tool (I) > Sprayer on the property bar > Category 'Objects' > Sprayer list 'spray_27'; pick it before dragging, or select an existing curve and pick it to spray along it (Effects > Artistic Media docker lists it too). Tune object size, Dabs / Spacing, Spray order and Rotation on the property bar. Script: the harvest records no call that applies a sprayer; the spraylist artwork is in C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Objects\spray_27.cdr. Scripted substitute: import that file and place copies along the path with SubPath.GetPointAt / SubPath.GetTangentAt + Shape.Duplicate (static copies with no live link to the path; not tested by the harvest).

verified.note: White business jet, jumbo airliner, small prop plane with blue stripe, blue-and-white helicopter and Concorde, mostly white and light grey.
